note: Canonical capability names. Python (avrana/contracts) and the browser probe (web/party/lib/capabilities.js) must use exactly these names; tests enforce it. 'label' and 'missing' are guest-facing words: no machinery terms.

secure_context.label: a secure connection
secure_context.missing: This page isn’t open on the secure Party address.

service_worker.label: an offline copy of the Party page
service_worker.missing: This browser can’t keep an offline copy of the Party page.

cache_storage.label: saved Party pages
cache_storage.missing: This browser can’t save Party pages.

websocket.summary: The WebSocket constructor exists (wss:// on the HTTPS origin).
websocket.label: a live connection to the party
websocket.missing: This browser can’t keep a live connection to the party.

webrtc.label: live game video
webrtc.missing: This browser can’t show live game video.

webrtc.data_channel.summary: RTCPeerConnection.prototype.createDataChannel exists; the deep probe opens a local loopback channel.
webrtc.data_channel.label: fast game controls
webrtc.data_channel.missing: This browser can’t use the fastest game controls.

video.h264.summary: RTCRtpReceiver.getCapabilities('video') lists H.264 (the Pi's hardware encoder output).
video.h264.label: the Party’s video format
video.h264.missing: This browser can’t play the Party’s video format.

web_audio.label: game sound
web_audio.missing: This browser can’t play game sound.

gamepad.summary: navigator.getGamepads exists (secure contexts only in current engines). Presence says nothing about a connected controller.
gamepad.label: game controller support
gamepad.missing: This browser can’t use a game controller.

wake_lock.summary: navigator.wakeLock exists (secure contexts only). A request still needs a visible page and can be refused.
wake_lock.label: keeping the screen on
wake_lock.missing: This phone may dim its screen while you play.

web_crypto.label: secure sign-in
web_crypto.missing: This browser can’t do secure sign-in.

storage.local.summary: A localStorage write/read/remove round trip succeeds.
storage.local.label: remembering you on this phone
storage.local.missing: This browser won’t remember you between visits.

storage.indexeddb.label: saving game data
storage.indexeddb.missing: This browser can’t save game data.

storage.persistent.summary: navigator.storage.persisted() resolves true. Never calls persist() (that can prompt).
storage.persistent.label: keeping saved data
storage.persistent.missing: This browser may clear saved Party data.

webgl.summary: A canvas returns a WebGL context.
webgl.label: 3D graphics

webgl2.summary: A canvas returns a WebGL2 context.
webgl2.label: advanced 3D graphics
webgl2.missing: This browser can’t draw advanced 3D graphics.

webgpu.summary: navigator.gpu.requestAdapter() resolves an adapter (async; never prompts).
webgpu.label: next-generation graphics
webgpu.missing: This browser can’t use next-generation graphics.

fullscreen.summary: document.fullscreenEnabled (or the webkit prefix) is true. iPhone Safari reports false for elements.
fullscreen.label: full screen
fullscreen.missing: This browser can’t go full screen.

vibration.label: vibration
vibration.missing: This phone won’t vibrate for game events.

media_devices.summary: navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia exists. Never called by the probe.
media_devices.label: camera and microphone access
media_devices.missing: This browser can’t use a camera or microphone.

microphone.summary: Permissions API reports microphone 'granted' (yes) or 'denied' (no); 'prompt' stays unknown. Never prompts.
microphone.label: the microphone
microphone.missing: The microphone isn’t allowed for the Party.

camera.summary: Permissions API reports camera 'granted' (yes) or 'denied' (no); 'prompt' stays unknown. Never prompts.
camera.label: the camera
camera.missing: The camera isn’t allowed for the Party.

touch.label: a touch screen
touch.missing: This device has no touch screen.

runtime.lan_games.summary: The LAN Games server (browser-native games) is installed on the appliance.
runtime.lan_games.label: the party games
runtime.lan_games.missing: The Party games aren’t installed on this Party box.

runtime.retroarch.summary: An emulator runtime (RetroArch with a pinned libretro core) can run on the appliance.
runtime.retroarch.label: the game player
runtime.retroarch.missing: This Party box can’t run this game.

input.virtual_gamepad.summary: Phone input can drive per-seat virtual controllers (live: Linux uinput for the arcade; experiment: XTest into a private X display for PS1).
input.virtual_gamepad.label: phone controllers
input.virtual_gamepad.missing: This Party box can’t turn phones into controllers.

presentation.shared_stream.summary: One encode of the whole frame fanned out to each phone (today: GStreamer webrtcbin + the Pi H.264 encoder).
presentation.shared_stream.label: video to phones
presentation.shared_stream.missing: This Party box can’t send game video to phones.

presentation.personal_viewport.crop.summary: A Personal Viewport made by cropping the shared frame per seat.
presentation.personal_viewport.crop.label: your own part of the screen
presentation.personal_viewport.crop.missing: This Party box can’t show each player their own part of the screen.

presentation.personal_viewport.dedicated.summary: A Personal Viewport rendered and encoded separately per seat.
presentation.personal_viewport.dedicated.label: your own game view
presentation.personal_viewport.dedicated.missing: This Party box can’t give each player their own game view.

presentation.tv.summary: A shared screen driven by the appliance (HDMI or a TV browser) shows the game.
presentation.tv.label: a TV
presentation.tv.missing: There’s no TV connected to the party.
